description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

A seeking talent’s range can bend around obstacles to reach the intended target. You can define the route yourself or unambiguously identify a target and allow the talent to determine its own path. However, the talent fails if it would have to travel farther than its maximum range to reach the identified target. A ranged attack roll made to deliver a seeking talent is not subject to cover or concealment. In order to benefit from this effect, the selected talent must have a range greater than touch and target one or more creatures, or it must require the caster to make a ranged touch attack.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Seeking Spell; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

The talent must have range greater than touch and target creatures, or require a ranged touch attack. Its route can bend around obstacles, but actual path length cannot exceed maximum range. Its delivery ranged attack ignores cover and concealment; unrelated attacks do not.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
